note: SI-generated: compiled by Claude Code (Anthropic) for the SunSight team from the cited NASA, NSSDCA, LROC and USGS pages on 2026-11-14. See SI_USE.md. Every coordinate is copied from source_url; source_quote holds the page text. Longitudes are east-positive, -180..180.

sites.name: IM-2 Athena target (Mons Mouton)
sites.source_quote: The Intuitive Machines IM-2 intended landing site (-84.78°, 29.13°E) is 160 kilometers from the south pole and 175 kilometers from the IM-1 landing site.
sites.notes: Intended site; two decimals (about 150 m precision).

sites.name: IM-2 Athena resting place
sites.source_quote: The IM-2 Athena lander hit the surface faster than intended and ended up on its side within a 20-meter diameter crater ( 84.7906° S, 29.1957° E ).
sites.notes: Actual. Same value in the NSSDCA lunar artifact table.
